summary: End-to-end verification of new Nellai Karupatti Coffee features: Regular/Contract employment_type, Previous Month Due carry-over, new leave-deduction rules, per-row View Breakup modal + CSV download. Backend pytest 29/29 PASS (17 regression + 12 new feature tests). Frontend UI flow at 1920x1080 verified: Contract toggle persists & renders as Contract badge in Type column; /salary table shows Type, Previous Month Due, and Net Payable columns; [data-testid='view-breakup-<id>'] opens modal with Leave/Advance/Previous breakup + working CSV download (breakup-Chandru-2026-05.csv) and [data-testid='breakup-close'] closes it. Minor: had to update two pre-existing assertions (TestSalary.test_salary_computation, TestCascadeDelete) because the NEW 'first 2 leaves free for Regular' rule changed expected deductions — these are test-data corrections, not business bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_month_breakdown is called twice per employee per GET /salary/month (current + previous). For a shop with few employees fine, but would become O(2N) DB round-trips — acceptable at this scale.

Previous-month lookup is intentionally 1-level (no recursion), so a chain of negative months will only carry the immediately preceding month, not the full arrears. This matches the spec ('Previous-month lookup is 1-level (no recursion)') — confirmed working correctly.
Salary.jsx imports `previous_month_due` from the row with fallback `|| 0` — good. CSV download uses a blob+anchor pattern which works in the Playwright download harness.

Breakup endpoint correctly returns `employee` meta (id/name/mobile/employment_type/status/joining_date), `per_day_rate`, `free_leave_days`, `chargeable_leave_days`, `advances[]` filtered to month, `previous_month_net`, `previous_month_due`, `net_payable` — all fields asserted.
Backend validates month format for breakup route (returns 400 for 2026-13) and returns 404 for unknown employee — both covered.
test_credentials: admin@workforce.com / admin123 (seeded by backend on startup)

Frontend also created TEST_UI_Contract_<ts> and deleted it via the UI. Verified only Chandru & Sowmiya remain.

Existing pre-existing employees Chandru and Sowmiya are preserved; do not delete. UI testids confirmed: form-employment-type-toggle, employment-type-<id>, view-breakup-<id>, breakup-download, breakup-close, breakup-net-payable, prev-due-<id>.
